source_reconstruction: Checkout the base Git commit, then overlay archived src/ files. The archive also retains the exact pre-evaluation proof, protocol and evaluator. Unchanged dependencies remain recoverable from Git.
evaluation: One reserved evaluation of the unchanged frozen three-component-path protocol after archiving proof, inputs, evaluator and exact runtime overlays. Current-source regression tests remain separate and preserve saved evidence.
scope: Conditional degree-aware composition of three actually formed C9 families: thirty retained coordinates, exact reduced balance, uniform full-state approximation on the declared finite window and separate full-law all-time identity/recovery. Supplied unit support, law, preparation, clock and work; no exact nonlinear quotient, autonomous event law, minimality, trajectory acquisition or physical identification.
provenance_limitations: Hashes establish content consistency and source recoverability, not independent authentication of chronology or physical acquisition.
